analytics.studentIntro: Your practice, your discoveries, your next step.
analytics.staffIntro: Teaching records you can explore and act on.
analytics.partialTime: Partial estimate. Missing time is not zero.
analytics.dueBatch: Homework due within the selected period; target rosters retained.
analytics.helpUnknown: External assistance is unknown; these are not verified independent results.
analytics.noCalibratedTrend: Observed results only. Question difficulty and assistance are not calibrated; no comparable progress claim.
analytics.chooseSkillNote: Try a few new questions. Repeating a question is useful, too.
analytics.sampledChart: Chart shows spaced dates; the data table contains every day.
analytics.pointsNote: Hollow points: fewer than 10 graded objective responses. No result means no point.
analytics.empty: No records in this range. Try another filter.
analytics.noSkills: Try a question to begin your learning story.
analytics.timeDefinition: Foreground question activity, capped after 90 seconds without interaction. Overlapping devices count once. Audio requires actual playback progress. Reading mode is an estimate.
analytics.recordedLearners: students with recorded intervals / students who submitted (different populations may overlap)
analytics.repetitionNote: Repeat answers remain separate from new questions.
analytics.scoreDefinition: Graded responses only, including manual and partial scores.
analytics.skillsNote: One primary skill per question. Practiced does not mean mastered. Click for supporting records.
analytics.noRanking: Alphabetical roster, no student ranking. Each cell shows correct / graded and sample size.
analytics.legacyTargets: Older target lists were reconstructed from enrollment at rollout and may be incomplete. They are not original frozen rosters.
analytics.classroomHoursNote: Overlapping confirmed intervals within each lesson count once. Lessons are then added.
analytics.teacherHoursNote: Each teacher’s overlapping intervals count once. Co-teaching can exceed classroom hours.
analytics.noTeacherRanking: Alphabetical teaching workload; not a teaching-quality ranking.
analytics.sessionPeriod: Lessons created in the selected period or with confirmed teaching during it. Each round remains distinct.
analytics.confirmTeachingNote: Enter the actual teaching interval using your device’s local time. Exclude pauses. Room-open duration is never inferred as teaching time.
analytics.contentNote: Published questions in this grade and language, in your authorized catalog. Available recordings do not prove playback or learning.
analytics.frozenTargets: Target rosters frozen when tasks are published
analytics.qualityNote: Live queries use the latest stored grades. Pending, hidden, missing and unpracticed are distinct. No admissions forecast or causal teaching assessment is generated.
analytics.scopeNote: Only the responsible teacher can share or revoke a class. The institution owner then sees that class’s teaching data, never private practice. Revocation applies immediately to new queries and exports.
analytics.disclaimer: Practice observations only, not an official exam score or admission prediction. Private family practice remains outside staff reports. Exports contain authorized aggregates only.

analytics.syncIncomplete: Some practice time has not synced
analytics.condition.unknown: No system hint recorded; external help unknown

ranking.subject: Subject
ranking.methodProgramme: Subject aggregates reproduce the official figures. Counts may include multiple competency results for the same pupil. This view does not assign school ranks.
ranking.title: Rankings
ranking.methodPrimary: Grade 6 rankings use the published pass rate for one competency. Schools need at least 15 public numeric results, and flagged small groups are excluded.
ranking.methodSecondary: Secondary rankings use the published mean for one June exam paper. School type, network and exam code define separate rankings.
ranking.privateMethod: Private rankings retain the source’s teaching-site scope and include only uniquely matched single-site schools.
ranking.coverageNote: Ranks cover matched schools with published results in the current Greater Montréal directory. No historical eligibility denominator has been confirmed. Location filters preserve the full ranking.
ranking.scopeNote: Results use the reporting unit and year stated in the source.
ranking.contextNote: Admissions and catchment rules depend on the year, program and home address.
